newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady in slow activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady in slow activity.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady on Friday, capping a week of featureless activity, dealers said.
Dealers said buyers and sellers have covered most of their needs for this week and early next week.
Buyers were expected to be out of the market until they use what they have, a North Carolina dealer said.
"They won't buy anymore until they chew it up," he said. Feed mixers were also continuing to use cheaper substitutes in their ingredients, he said.
"Everybody is waiting," a Midwest dealer said, in describing the quiet tone in the market.
